# Test that generated code handles various function signatures correctly
# This validates the parser's ability to handle different parameter types

env INPUT_DIR=$HOME/.appledocs/cache/developer.apple.com/tutorials/data/documentation

mkdir parser_output

# Generate CoreGraphics which has diverse function signatures
exec generate-framework-bindings -framework CoreGraphics -input $INPUT_DIR -output parser_output

# Verify common CGRect functions are generated
grep 'CGRectGetMinX' parser_output/coregraphics/functions.gen.go
grep 'CGRectGetMaxX' parser_output/coregraphics/functions.gen.go

# Verify CGRect type exists
grep 'CGRect' parser_output/coregraphics/types.gen.go

# Verify CGFloat type exists
grep 'CGFloat' parser_output/coregraphics/types.gen.go

# Check that reference types are handled
grep 'CGContext' parser_output/coregraphics/functions.gen.go
